Title: Boulder City Council Meeting - Thursday, October 5, 2023 (Regular Meeting)

Topic1.Title: Meeting Opening, Agenda Amendment, and Proclamations
Topic1.Summary: Council announced the Better Public Meetings Project scorecard and called the meeting to order with roll call. Council unanimously amended the agenda to add a National Domestic Violence Month declaration and a notice of intent for safe outdoor spaces. Indigenous Peoples' Day and National Domestic Violence Month declarations were presented and read into the record.

Topic2.Title: Open Comment Period
Topic2.Summary: Thirteen in-person and virtual speakers addressed Council on topics including rowing access and reservoir fees, pollinator gardens, Boulder Creek path lighting, a Third Street intersection, Fulam Street bike conditions, homelessness, historic preservation, a highway merge design, and a stolen bag incident at city offices. Staff responded to several comments, including rowing fees, the Civic Area historic district application, and transportation concerns. Council discussed the NAACP-related comments and staff clarified the position on a deputy chief's testimony.

Topic3.Title: Consent Agenda and Boards/Commissions Recognition
Topic3.Summary: Council reviewed a presentation by Open Space staff on prairie dog management on irrigated agricultural lands and adopted the consent agenda items A through G, with the mayor pro tem voting no on item G. Council also praised the City Manager and City Attorney evaluation process. Discussion included questions on the police oversight ordinance, a letter to County Commissioners, and Council travel and training.

Topic4.Title: Public Hearing: Annexation at 3033 Third Street (Ordinance 8582 and Resolution 1333)
Topic4.Summary: Staff presented the annexation of approximately 0.27 acres at 3033 Third Street with an initial zoning designation of RL-1, noting the site is partly in Area 2 and partly in Area 3 with a scenic easement. Council adopted Resolution 1333 and Ordinance 8582 unanimously after no members of the public spoke. Staff noted the site meets annexation requirements and inclusionary housing terms apply.

Topic5.Title: Public Hearing: 2024 Budget Adoption (Ordinances 8595-8598)
Topic5.Summary: Staff presented the recommended 2024 budget of approximately $14.8 million across all funds, a general fund of $16.1 million, and the Capital Improvement Program. Council reviewed ten proposed changes, including reallocating funds from safe and managed public spaces, adding funds to pavement management and underpass lighting, supporting community connectors, and increasing ambassador program wages. Council adopted the budget ordinances with the approved additions, including $500,000 for pavement management and $30,000 for underpass lighting, and $10,000 for community connectors.

Topic6.Title: Matters from Council: Safe Outdoor Spaces Notice of Intent
Topic6.Summary: Council discussed a proposal to pilot a safe outdoor space for approximately 25 people using savings from the day shelter budget, with possible additions for portable bathrooms, showers, and safe parking. Staff were directed to return with costs and implementation details, and Council voted by a majority to approve the notice of intent. Council members also noted upcoming responsibilities, including Matt Benjamin's role as chair of the Colorado Municipal League policy committee.
